Review the counterevidence before prioritising this audience.

incumbent_behaviour.text: A product-management commentator describes choosing Balsamiq over other wireframing tools for its simplicity, and separately reports a prior tool (Mockflow) as unintuitive and limited in its free trial.

evidence.quote: My wireframing tool of choice, as it’s very simple to use, doesn’t have too many features and thus allows you to focus on the basics.

I’ve used this in the past but the general user experience wasn’t very intuitive and with a limit on the number of pages you can have in the free trial (3) meant that I didn’t want to be using this long-term.

incumbent_behaviour.inference_basis: Tier 3 article; presented as the author's personal experience, not corroborated buyer evidence for this segment generally.; Historical sources (2021-04-21); present applicability is not corroborated.

incumbent_behaviour.text: The same commentator also considered flowcharting tools (e.g. Draw.io) and plain paper/pencil sketches as alternatives to dedicated wireframing software for low-fidelity work.

evidence.quote: More of a flowcharting tool that can be used for wireframes, but ultimately if your app or webpage is boxy and pretty standard then it does an OK job.

Ask yourself how complicated your wireframes really need to be. Do they need full-page layouts, or can you get away with small feature mockups? If less is needed then you can always resort to pencil and paper.

incumbent_behaviour.inference_basis: Tier 3 single-author account of personal tool evaluation, not verified as representative.; Historical sources (2021-04-21); present applicability is not corroborated.

desired_outcomes.text: The stated intent of wireframing, per a product-management commentator, is to represent the elements and user journeys of a screen so a team can review and align before further design/engineering work proceeds.

evidence.quote: The intention of a wireframe is to get down onto paper / monitor the elements that will be present on the final screen, and this allows you to show user journeys and actions, i.e. what your user wants to achieve.

desired_outcomes.inference_basis: Tier 3 single-author description of the purpose of wireframing, not a buyer's direct statement of desired outcome.; Historical sources (2021-04-21); present applicability is not corroborated.
